chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Khalaf ibn Hammad, he raised it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding
the one who delays (paying the dowry), either he reconciles (pays) or he divorces (her). So if he does it, or else his neck is struck.

key_terms.الْمُؤْلِي: One who delays (specifically in paying the deferred dowry)
key_terms.ضُرِبَتْ عُنُقُهُ: His neck is struck (a specific corporal punishment)
key_terms.يَفِيءَ: He reconciles or pays the debt

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a husband who delays paying his wife's dowry?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the ruling for a husband who delays paying the deferred dowry (mahr), presenting him with two options: pay the debt or divorce his wife. If he fails to do either, the penalty is striking his neck. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it emphasizes the husband's obligation to fulfill his financial duties to his wife, and if he fails to do so, the penalty is striking his neck.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding
the solemn oather, either he meets (reconciles) or he divorces. So if he does it, or else his neck is struck’.
en.sarwar: 10. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman who has said the following: About the case of a man’s 7/a’ (swearing) abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that if he refuses to divorce
’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, that an enclosure of reeds must be made for him and to keep him there without food and drink until he agrees to divorce.’”
